lines.narrationArabic: بعد يوم الحديقة، يلتقي ليث فينسنت قرب السوق ويقرر مساعدة مارثا.

scenes.purposeArabic: التحدث عن لقاء حديث وتحديد وقت بسيط.

lines.targetText: Buongiorno, Laith. Ti ho visto al Garden Day.
lines.englishReference: Good morning, Laith. I saw you at the garden day.
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير يا ليث. I saw you at the garden day.
lines.pronunciation: Buongiorno, Laith. Ti ho visto al Garden Day.

lines.targetText: Buongiorno. Lì ho incontrato molte persone.
lines.englishReference: Good morning. I met many people there.
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير. I met many people there.
lines.pronunciation: Buongiorno. Lì ho incontrato molte persone.

lines.englishReference: Do you want to know the village better?
lines.arabicTranslation: Do you want to know the village better?

lines.targetText: SÌ. Voglio conoscere meglio i miei vicini.
lines.englishReference: Yes. I want to know my neighbors better.
lines.arabicTranslation: Yes. I want to know my neighbors better.
lines.pronunciation: SÌ. Voglio conoscere meglio i miei vicini.

lines.targetText: Martha ha bisogno di aiuto al mercato oggi.
lines.englishReference: Martha needs help at the market today.
lines.arabicTranslation: Martha needs help at the market today.
lines.pronunciation: Martha ha bisogno di aiuto al mercato oggi.

lines.englishReference: I can meet her after breakfast.
lines.arabicTranslation: I can meet her after breakfast.

lines.englishReference: That sounds like a good plan.

scenes.promptArabic: انقل مهارة اليوم إلى حياتك: مقابلة جار أو زميل بعد نشاط جماعي.

scenes.purposeArabic: استماع جانبي طبيعي بلا كشف مبكر.

lines.targetText: Il mercato sta cambiando rapidamente in questa stagione.
lines.englishReference: The market is changing quickly this season.
lines.pronunciation: Il mercato sta cambiando rapidamente in questa stagione.

lines.targetText: SÌ. Le persone fanno più domande sulle vecchie strade.
lines.englishReference: Yes. People are asking more questions about old roads.
lines.arabicTranslation: نعم. الناس يسألون أكثر عن الطرق القديمة.
lines.pronunciation: SÌ. Le persone fanno più domande sulle vecchie strade.
